name: Mission
source: Environment and Climate Change Canada, Water Survey of Canada (HYDAT daily means + real-time)
credit: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Canada (Environment and Climate Change Canada)
flag_rule: HYDAT (approved) days are measured, except symbols B (ice) and E (estimated), which are estimated; real-time days are provisional.
notes: Water Survey of Canada computes discharge from the water level through a stage-discharge rating curve, checked against periodic field measurements (Environment and Climate Change Canada).
Mission is tidal and its own discharge record is near-complete only from 1965 to the early 1990s, so this is the flow at Hope, 68 km upstream (Environment and Climate Change Canada).
The Harrison River and other tributaries join between Hope and Mission, so flow at Mission is higher than the flow shown here (Environment and Climate Change Canada).

Approved daily means (HYDAT) run from 1912-03-01 to 2025-02-24. Discharge symbols: {'none': 39225, 'Ice Conditions': 830, 'Estimated': 691, 'Partial Day': 523}. Ice conditions (B) and estimated (E) are marked estimated; partial day (A) and other symbols stay measured. Skipped 4 HYDAT days with no discharge and 0 negative values (Environment and Climate Change Canada).

After HYDAT ends: 5-minute real-time readings (2025-03-17 to 2026-10-17 UTC) averaged into 570 daily means by local standard time day. A day needs readings in at least 20 of its 24 hours; 3 days left out. All real-time days are provisional, or estimated if any reading has symbol B or E. Approval of the readings: {'Provisional/Provisoire': 164549}; symbols: {'none': 164549} (Environment and Climate Change Canada).

No data from 2025-02-25 to the day before 2025-03-18: approved daily means are not yet published for that period and the real-time service keeps only about 18 months (Environment and Climate Change Canada).
Station status: Active (Environment and Climate Change Canada).
